fusions.name: Tear Off a Haunch
fusions.desc: Tears a mouthful from the target with a bite that deals 8 damage and uses up every affliction on it, adding 1.2 times the damage they had left. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Banquet Brawl
fusions.desc: Overturns the table: it deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Gorge to Bursting
fusions.desc: Increases your maximum health by 15% for 15 seconds, and you regain 12 health at once.

fusions.name: Fresh Kill
fusions.desc: Whenever you kill an enemy, you regenerate 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
